build_bert_model: build a BERT model with BertModel class for bidirectional embedding representations from a Transformer
create_bert_config: create a BertConfig instance from a JSON config file or vocabulary size for BERT model parameters
load_pretrained_bert: load a pretrained BERT model from HuggingFace or local checkpoint with BertPreTrainedModel.from_pretrained
run_sequence_classification: run sequence classification with BertForSequenceClassification using pooled output and a linear classifier
run_question_answering: run span extraction question answering with BertForQuestionAnswering computing start and end logits
